excluded_initial_attempt.gate_failure_description: Parent reports allowed_tools list/dict readback normalization; no model responses from this attempt were included.

limitations: This is a post-hoc audit of six custom prompts on five small synthetic sources, not the complete twelve-question gold benchmark or a statistical quality estimate.
The not_stated/absence question Q04 was not exercised. Gold A03 and A05 were not requested in the native answers.
Image transcription accuracy against pixels remains UNKNOWN. Matching saved transcript evidence and faithful uncertainty wording do not establish visual correctness.
CSV/PPTX/PNG answer semantics are mapped to memo-a hand-gold assertions using matching source quotes; independent format-specific gold and pixel-location annotations were not created.
Retrieval returned documents from other source formats too. All answer citations obeyed requested source scope; retrieval itself was not source-isolated.
Extracted assertions remain model_candidate. This manual synthetic evaluation does not validate arbitrary documents or promote all model extractions to authoritative ontology facts.
Citation URLs were checked as stored identifiers only. No URLs, live services or authorization states were queried by this auditor.
